Write any positions as [y, x]. Compute destination target x minus departure target x to determine horizontal direction; do not use a local reversal in wrist x. Judge the arc using the substantial interior wrist excursion relative to the line joining that row's endpoint wrist positions, not a near-arrival sample that may belong to the next crossing. For endpoint wrist positions [y0, x0] and [y1, x1] and an interior wrist sample [ys, xs], when x1 differs from x0, baseline_y = y0 + (y1 - y0) * (xs - x0) / (x1 - x0). Negative ys minus baseline_y indicates upper; positive indicates lower. Use wrist coordinates throughout this baseline calculation. Reversing horizontal direction does not by itself change the side of the baseline occupied by the arc.
